verdict.rationale: dlt documents automatic schema inference and evolution, normalization/unnesting of nested JSON into typed tables, and merge/upsert deduplication via primary_key/merge_key, resulting in clean queryable destination tables rather than raw blobs (dlt-docs-2, -18, -20, -35, -37, -54). This is corroborated by community feedback praising the schema auto-generation and flattening making raw tables cleaner (dlt-comm-4), though one commenter voices philosophical objection to automatic schema evolution (dlt-comm-5) which is a preference concern, not a hands-on failure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of deduplication correctness at scale beyond docs and forum praise.
